findings.title: ERC4626 Share Transfer Bypass of Stake Locks
findings.description: StakeVault inherits ERC4626 but fails to override _update(), allowing users to transfer shares while bypassing contributor and validator stake locks. This completely negates the economic security model.

evidence_locations.code: contract StakeVault is ERC4626Upgradeable, AccessControlUpgradeable, PausableUpgradeable, UUPSUpgradeable, IStakeVault

findings.exploit_sketch:
1. User stakes tokens and sets validator capacity (locks stake)
2. User transfers ERC4626 shares to a new address via transfer()
3. New address redeems shares for underlying tokens
4. Original account still shows locked stake but has no assets
5. Slashing operations fail, all stake operations break
findings.impact: Complete bypass of staking mechanism, permanent loss of slashing capability
findings.mitigation: Override _update() to prevent all share transfers when sender has locked balances

findings.title: Missing ENGINE_ROLE Grant to QualityEngine
findings.description: StakeVault functions require ENGINE_ROLE, but QualityEngine.initialize() never grants this role to itself. Vault operations will revert, breaking core staking functionality.
findings.exploit_sketch: Deploy contracts → Attempt to claimToContribute → vault.lockContributor() reverts with AccessControl error → All staking operations fail
findings.impact: Protocol completely non-functional, no staking possible
findings.mitigation: Grant ENGINE_ROLE to QualityEngine address during initialization

findings.title: Validator Settlement Blocked on Contribution Rejection
findings.description: computeConsensus sets report.computed=true only on contribution acceptance, but settleValidator requires computed=true. Rejected contributions leave validators with permanently locked stake.
findings.exploit_sketch:
1. Submit low-quality contribution
2. Validators commit and reveal scores
3. Consensus computes rejection, increments nonce
4. Validators attempt to settle → revert because computed=false
5. Validator stake permanently locked
findings.impact: Validators lose stake on routine rejections, economic security degrades
findings.mitigation: Set computed=true regardless of acceptance/rejection outcome

findings.title: Zero-Stake Validation Bypass
findings.description: Zero-stake validations allowed despite minimum stake enforcement. ConsensusLib gives weight=1 to zero-stake validators, enabling Sybil attacks.

evidence_locations.code: uint256 w = sqrtStake * effectiveRep; if (w == 0) w = 1;

findings.exploit_sketch:
1. Create multiple accounts with zero stake
2. Commit zero-stake validations with arbitrary scores
3. Reveal to manipulate consensus outcome
4. Consensus weights zero-stake validators equally to legitimate ones
findings.impact: Free consensus manipulation, undermines validation economics
findings.mitigation: Enforce minimum stake > 0 and reject zero-stake validations

findings.title: Escrow Underflow in Validator Settlement
findings.description: settleValidator deducts validator rewards without checking escrow sufficiency. Multiple settlements can deplete escrow before individual claims.
findings.exploit_sketch:
1. Multiple validators settle simultaneously
2. Each settlement deducts from escrow without coordination
3. Later settlements hit zero balance, revert
4. Validators cannot claim earned rewards
findings.mitigation: Check escrow sufficiency before reward deduction or use coordinated settlement

findings.title: Consensus Storage Collision on Resubmission
findings.cwe: CWE-349: Acceptance of Extraneous Untrusted Data With Trusted Data
findings.description: validatorConsensus mapping keyed by (projectId, index, validator) not by nonce. Resubmitted contributions at same index collide with previous consensus results.
findings.exploit_sketch:
1. Submit contribution at index 0, gets rejected
2. Index 0 gets resubmitted with new nonce
3. Same validators participate in new round
4. Old ValidatorConsensusResult data interferes with new settlement
findings.impact: Validators cannot settle on resubmissions, stake locked
findings.mitigation: Key validatorConsensus by nonce: (projectId, index, nonce, validator)

findings.title: Arithmetic Overflow in Consensus Calculation
findings.description: ConsensusLib.calculate() performs score * weight * PRECISION multiplication without overflow checks. Large stake amounts can cause uint256 overflow.
findings.exploit_sketch:
1. Validator with extremely large stake amount participates
2. w = sqrt(large_stake) * reputation becomes very large
3. score * w * PRECISION overflows uint256
4. Consensus calculation reverts or produces incorrect results
findings.mitigation: Use SafeMath or check for overflow in multiplications

findings.title: Malicious Adapter Token Transfer Manipulation
findings.description: Adapter contracts can implement arbitrary logic in transferFrom calls. Malicious adapters could selectively fail or manipulate transfers.
findings.exploit_sketch:
1. Deploy malicious adapter that checks msg.sender
2. Adapter succeeds for legitimate users but fails for specific targets
3. Use adapter in fundProject to prevent targeted users from funding
4. Selective censorship of project funding
findings.impact: Censorship of users, project funding manipulation
findings.mitigation: Validate adapter contracts or remove adapter abstraction

findings.title: Hardcoded Consensus Algorithm Bypass
findings.cwe: CWE-710: Improper Adherence to Coding Standards
findings.description: Consensus algorithm address stored but ConsensusLib.calculate() called directly. Pluggable consensus feature exists but is unused.
findings.exploit_sketch: Future upgrade attempts to use pluggable consensus fail because code path calls ConsensusLib directly
findings.mitigation: Use stored consensusAlgorithm address for calculations

findings.title: Fee-on-Transfer Token Accounting Errors
findings.description: fundProject handles fee-on-transfer tokens but other token operations may not account for actual received amounts.
findings.exploit_sketch:
1. Use fee-on-transfer reward token
2. claimReward transfers expected amount but token deducts fee
3. User receives less than expected, accounting inconsistent
findings.impact: User receives less than earned rewards
findings.mitigation: Measure actual transferred amounts in all token operations

findings.title: Validator Capacity Lock Without Unlock Path
findings.description: setValidatorCapacity locks stake but reduceValidatorCapacity only reduces committed capacity, not total capacity. No way to fully unlock validator stake.
findings.exploit_sketch:
1. Validator sets capacity for validation
2. After participating, wants to unlock all stake
3. reduceValidatorCapacity only unlocks from capacity pool
4. Stake remains locked permanently
findings.impact: Validators cannot exit or reduce commitment
findings.mitigation: Add function to fully unlock validator capacity

findings.title: Reputation Manipulation via Zero Hash Bypass
findings.description: bytes32(0) commit hash bypasses duplicate prevention, allowing infinite zero-hash commits that manipulate reputation decay.
findings.exploit_sketch:
1. Commit with bytes32(0) hash (now blocked)
2. System allows multiple commits with same hash
3. Spam commits to waste gas and manipulate timing
4. Reputation system affected by repeated operations
findings.mitigation: Maintain zero hash rejection for consistency

risk_assessment.deployment_risk: HIGH - Multiple critical issues prevent proper functioning
risk_assessment.economic_security: BROKEN - Share transfers bypass locks, stake operations fail
risk_assessment.recommendation: DO NOT DEPLOY - Address all CRITICAL and HIGH severity findings first
